reference_identification.caveat: Known/invariant full-column-rank measurement and positive initial states; independent randomized activity. Not claimed as a new theorem.

endpoint_counterexample.scope: Endpoint-only assessments with equal activity counts; both AB and BA orders fail here. Does not establish nonidentification when informative intermediate responses are retained.

adaptive_support.scope: Exact enumeration of a correctly specified model with sequential observed-history randomization. This illustrates support equivalence, not a general proof or finite-sample variance guarantee.

buffer_policy_extrema.scope: All count configurations at exactly 18 retained responses; some may be unreachable under a particular scheduled design.

recovery_implementation.scope: Arithmetic/likelihood check; does not prove global optimization or interval coverage.
